name: Mark
headline: Turn KLM’s booking data into repeat trips that stay.
saw: Your homepage sells flights, seats, check-in, hotels and last minute deals to every visitor in much the same way, whether they arrive to book a trip or to join Flying Blue.

Once someone has flown with you, the signal you already own is which routes they book, when they travel, which seats they pick and which deals they ignore. Today that sits in analytics, not in the message they receive.

Cross-sell, upsell and retention campaigns are typically built by hand, per segment, per month. The traveller who is about to stop booking this week gets the same offer as everyone else, or none at all.
help_intro: Three places where an AI that decides per customer, not per segment, pays for itself in the first quarter.

cases.head: Stop the lapse before it happens
cases.text: Per-customer churn signals from booking gaps, app use and deal opens, with the right offer, channel and moment chosen for each traveller across app, email and push.
cases.kpi_label: lower churn, measured at Flytxt telecom clients

cases.head: Offer the right extra, not every extra
cases.text: Next best offer per customer for seats, hotels, Flying Blue status and trip add-ons, triggered by the booking. No more blanket deal mails to travellers already on the right fare.
cases.kpi_label: category subscriptions at an OTT client

cases.head: Keep travellers engaged between trips
cases.text: Personal content in the app, push and email: destination guides, check-in reminders and deals matched to each traveller’s past routes, so every customer has a reason to open KLM again.
cases.kpi_label: streaming activity at an OTT client
